subject: Q3 narrative & OKR wrap — scoring inputs and contrarian notes
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 narrative & OKR wrap — scoring inputs and contrarian notes

Team —

Attached is my draft of the Q3 narrative and the working scoring sheet (Q3_scoring_sheet_v3.csv). High level: I pushed for clearer evidence columns and a conservative treatment for any metric with single-source attribution (we want to avoid over-crediting product experiments that were coincident with price changes).

Two asks before I consolidate for the Exec packet on Friday:
- Please add concrete evidence lines in the spreadsheet for any +1 or -1 adjustments you propose (link the evidence-pack if you have it).
- Flag any objective where you want a short contrarian sidebar (one-paragraph justification); I want these called out separately in the narrative.

Initial view: most objectives land in the green with nuance on Delivery Reliability (infra incidents pushed it to a 0.6 -> 0.5 range for me) and Sales Efficiency (across two deals we saw noisy attribution; I gave a provisional 0.7).

Attachments: Q3_scoring_sheet_v3.csv, evidence-pack.pdf, narrative-digest.docx

Thanks — please keep comments inline in the sheet; I will compile a single narrative that includes two contrarian callouts max.

Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q3_scoring_sheet_v3.csv (CSV, 58KB)]
[Attachment: evidence-pack.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 narrative & OKR wrap — scoring inputs and contrarian notes

Laura —

Thanks for the draft. Quick thoughts inline below; I also edited row 12 and added an evidence pointer to the scoring sheet (see cell comment).

On Delivery Reliability: I agree incidents >0.5 are honest — there are two items I want to call out before committing to a 0.5. First, the rollback we did on 8/11 materially reduced customer impact; I left a note with timestamps and the incident ticket. Second, we should ensure the narrative acknowledges mitigations we put in place (runbook, smoke tests) even if the score reflects historical pain.

On Sales Efficiency: I pushed a conservative adjustment for the Acme deal given the heavy discounting in the final mile; I put the proposed -0.2 in the sheet and linked an email thread from the AE. If Finance disagrees we can annotate the narrative that the metric is contested and include a short footnote.

Small editorial: please avoid long lists in the exec one-pager — two bullet takeaways per objective is enough.

Vivek
Head of Engineering
Redwood Inference

Laura / team —

I pulled the scoring sheet into a tidy view and added the final evidence bullets for the Sales Efficiency objective (rows 18-21). I'm attaching the updated CSV (still named Q3_scoring_sheet_v3.csv) and a short change log. Key changes I made:
- Acme attribution: I marked it as disputed and added the AE email and deal terms as evidence.
- Delivery Reliability: I added the incident ticket links and the runbook update PR that mitigated regression risk.
- Customer Outcomes objective: two customers cited as references; I added quotes to the evidence-pack.

One ask: can Rishi confirm the Finance stance on deal-level attribution? If Finance wants us to normalize for discounts we need to call that out in the narrative now.

Attachments: Q3_scoring_sheet_v3.csv (updated), change-log.txt, narrative-digest.docx (tracked changes)

Marissa Cole

Team / Alice —

Thanks for the quick turn. I pulled the worksheet together, incorporated Vivek's incident notes, and accepted Marissa's edits on Sales Efficiency with the explicit caveat that Finance will weigh in on discount normalization. Rishi — please confirm or object to the Acme attribution by EOD Monday; if I don't hear back I'll include the contested-footnote language Marissa drafted.

I've attached the final deliverables and the one-page exec summary that will go to the Exec packet. For transparency I kept two contrarian sidebars in the narrative (Delivery Reliability and Sales Efficiency) — both are short, factual, and call out mitigation actions and contested metrics.

Next steps:
1) Rishi to confirm Finance call on attribution (deadline: 2026-09-07 18:00 PDT).
2) Marissa to publish the evidence-pack to the shared Drive link and notify CS contacts (Acme).
3) I will route the exec one-pager to the Exec team and attach the scoring CSV.

Operational notes: I requested an SLA exception for the customer-impact incident retro (ticket: INF-2026-792) so that we can keep the relevant logs accessible for audit for an extra 30 days — contracts@docusign.com is CC'd for recordkeeping.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Aq3-Q3-closure-playbook
